_comment: Advanced settings live under the "settings" key of config.json, in the shape shown below. Edit them there, or use the in-app settings menu. Any key you omit falls back to the default shown here; a value of the wrong type or outside its range is reported by name at startup and replaced by the default. max_height is 1080, 1440, 2160 or null (no cap). retries is a whole number or "infinite". allow_external_config lets yt-dlp also read your own yt-dlp.conf (off by default: the app's settings then decide everything). speed_test turns the short connection-speed measurement before a playlist download on or off. The output templates below already contain %(id)s: without the video id two videos with the same title would share one file.
